examples.en: Non-smoking is now the norm in most workplaces.
examples.zh: 大多数工作场所现在都已禁止吸烟。

examples.en: Our modern workplaces also operate based on outdated time constraints.
examples.zh: 我们现代的工作场所也是基于过时的时间限制而运作的。

examples.en: We predict this will dramatically reduce absenteeism in our schools and workplaces.
examples.zh: 我们预计，这将大大减少学校和工作场所的旷工现象。
